summary: DueByte 0.3.60 fixes Home connection progress, missing timestamps and wallet verification after compact-state bootstrap. Snapshot parts and verified blocks are shown as distinct stages. Existing chain, wallets, balances, validator rules and issuance settings are unchanged. Home59 updates automatically; Linux Server updates manually. No issuance, warmup or mainnet exchange is activated. Windows executable is not Microsoft-code-signed; verify the signed DueByte update channel. The candidate notice inside the immutable archive is superseded by this release notice.
